subject: Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. 15-May-2026
narrative:
All,

Please see the below Vessel Movement plan for next 48hrs.:


Allianz Juno…



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Shuaiba Port, Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.
  *   Tomorrow 16th May, Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Dragon via NSBP with Crew Change Pax, ETD at 08.00hrs.
  *   Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Phoenix from Rig OD-1 with Pax then return to Shuaiba Port Via North Port.



  Crest Argus 1…



  *   Vessel currently enroute to Rig Oriental Dragon-1, ETA at Rig OD-1 at 19.40 Hrs. Vessel will STBY at OD-1.
  *   Tomorrow 16th May, Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Phoenix once Vessel Crest Argus-5 arrives at Rig OD-1. ETD 17.00Hrs.


Crest Argus 3…



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.
  *   Tomorrow 16th May, Vessel will sail to Shuaiba Port once Vessel Crest Argus-1 arrives at Rig OPH, ETD, 23.30 Hrs.



Crest Argus 5….



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Oriental Dragon-1, Vessel will sail to Shuaiba Port, ETD 20.0hrs.
  *   Tomorrow 16th May, Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Dragon-1, ETD 14.00hrs.



Crew change details will be sent by Rig Logistics/ Aisha/ Ahmed Modather.



Gary,

Kindly approve the above Vessel Movement Plan.

Regards,
